item.title: New Single from Beartooth “Free” on Fearless Records / Concord
item.description: BEARTOOTH SHARES NEW SINGLE “FREE” IMPACTING NOW Today, Beartooth return with a new single, “Free.” The track was co-written and co-produced by Jordan Fish and marks both the band’s first new music since 2023 and the start of a bold new era after signing to Fearless Records. The song arrives as they are on the road for a North American arena tour as the direct support for Bad Omens. Where past records chronicled survival, “Free” marks a turning point, capturing a moment of clarity inside chaos.
